title: How to Download Instagram Videos and Reels on Phone and Laptop
description: Download Instagram videos and Reels to your phone or laptop with no app and no login. Copy the link, paste it into I Need Save and pick a video quality.
photoCaption: Copying a link in the Instagram app.
photo2Caption: Pasting a Reels link into I Need Save.
body:
Ever come across a funny Reel, a cooking tutorial or an inspiring video you want to watch again later without hunting for it? Good news: you can download Instagram videos and Reels right from your browser with I Need Save. No app to install, no login, and it's just as easy on a phone as on a laptop.

Let's go through the steps, the file options you'll get, and a few things worth knowing before you start.

What Instagram Content Can You Download?

I Need Save works with public posts on Instagram. That means videos or Reels from accounts that aren't private can usually be saved. Besides videos, you can also grab the photo or thumbnail from the post.

One thing to know up front: Instagram sometimes blocks requests or asks for a login. When that happens, the download can fail even if the post is public. Usually you just need to try again a little later.

How to Download Instagram Reels on Your Phone

These steps work on Android and iPhone.

  1. Open the Instagram app and play the Reel or video you want to save.
  2. Tap the Share button on the post.
  3. Choose Copy link.
  4. Open your browser and go to ineedsave.com.
  5. Paste the link into the box, or tap the Paste button to make it quicker.
  6. Press Download, then wait for the list of options to appear.
  7. Pick the video quality you want, and the file will start downloading.

For some videos, the button may show Preparing…. That means the video is being processed first, for example by joining the video and audio together. Just wait; the download starts automatically once the file is ready.

How to Download Instagram Videos on a Laptop

If you mostly use Instagram on a computer, it's just as simple:

  1. Open Instagram in your browser and click the video post or Reel you want.
  2. Copy its link from the Share menu or from your browser's address bar.
  3. Open a new tab, go to the I Need Save downloader page, and paste the link.
  4. Click Download and pick the option you need.

The file will be saved in the Downloads folder on your computer.

Why Is Using the Browser More Convenient?

Downloading through a website has a few perks. You don't need to install an app that eats up storage, you don't have to hand over your login details, and the process is the same on every device. The I Need Save site is also available in 93 languages and automatically follows your phone's light or dark theme, so it's comfortable to use any time. Besides Instagram, you can use the same method for TikTok, Facebook, X (Twitter) and Pinterest.

File Options Available

Once the link is processed, you'll see several options. How many and which ones depend on the original post:

  • Video in several qualities, such as 360p, 720p or 1080p.
  • Audio in original quality, or a 192 kbps MP3 converted from the video. Handy if you only need the voice or background music.
  • Photo / Thumbnail from the post.

Tip: If your phone storage is filling up, choose 720p. The picture still looks clear on a phone screen, but the file is smaller than 1080p.

Finding the Video After Downloading

Once the download finishes, here's where your file is:

  • Android: open the Downloads folder with your file manager app. The Gallery app may take a moment before the video appears there.
  • iPhone/iPad (Safari): open the Files app, then go to the Downloads folder. To move the video into the Photos app, open it in Files, tap Share, then choose Save Video.

Still can't find your file? Our guide on where downloads are saved on Android and iPhone covers it in more detail.

One more reassuring thing: files are streamed directly from Instagram to your device and are not stored on the I Need Save server.

Why Won't an Instagram Video Download?

If the process fails, check these possibilities:

  • The post is from a private account. Private content can't be downloaded.
  • The content can only be viewed after logging in, or it's restricted to certain regions.
  • Instagram is currently blocking requests or asking for a login. Try again a little later.
  • The pasted link isn't a post link, for example a profile link. Copy it again from the Share button on the post itself.

Respect the Creator's Work

Use the videos you download for personal use only. If you want to repost one, ask the creator for permission first and give clear credit. Creators work hard on their content, so their copyright deserves respect.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to log in to Instagram to download?

No. Just paste the link of a public post into I Need Save, no login of any kind required.

Can I download Reels from a private account?

No. Content from private accounts, content that requires a login and region-restricted content can't be downloaded. Only public posts are supported.

Can I save photos from an Instagram post?

Yes. After pressing Download, choose the Photo / Thumbnail option from the list.
